target_customer: Accounting firms and retail, restaurant and other SMB clients in Colombia and Mexico
problem: Accounting teams spend hours capturing, classifying, posting and reconciling invoices and tax documents that arrive from the tax authority and email.
business_model: B2B SaaS for accounting firms and businesses; pricing not stated
product_category: AI accounting agents with ERP and POS integration

founders.name: Juan Pisco
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Connects to the Colombian tax authority DIAN, classifies invoices (company claims 98.7 percent accuracy per press) and syncs to ERPs; standard engineering with local compliance complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration with DIAN and Mexican CFDI rules plus local ERP and POS connectors raise copying costs for foreign entrants, though local rivals could add AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or acquiring Cifrato; aggregators show Siigo and Alegra as the dominant local accounting platforms.

market_need_then: Colombian electronic invoicing is mandated through DIAN and accounting firms process high invoice volumes manually; the site claims 3.5k plus companies served and press cites about 1M ARR in the first year.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself; name origin not found. A different blockchain brand called Cifr appeared in searches.

outcome_analysis: Cifrato is a Winter 2025 company serving Colombian and Mexican accounting firms with AI agents on top of mandated e-invoicing. Press reports about 1M ARR and 270 plus clients in year one and a seed of just over 1M in March 2026, which points to early product market fit. The company is active with no exit.
notes: Seed amount is reported as over 1M; exact amount unknown, 1M used as floor. Caplight lists total funding of 2M which conflicts and is unverified. Press names Yerson Cacua as co-founder but the YC page lists only Juan Pisco, so he is not listed as a founder. Traction figures of 1M ARR and 270 clients come from one profile and are unverified. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found; Siigo and Alegra appear only on undated aggregator pages.
